items.title: An alternative to LLM quality gates: deterministic routing + sampling
items.author: zxpmail
items.rawContent: Every "agent quality gate" I tested shares one fatal assumption: that an LLM can judge whether an LLM...
items.summary: 本文批判现有大语言模型（LLM）质量门控机制的固有缺陷，提出“确定性路由+采样”作为替代方案，并探讨其在AI代理系统中的理论优势与实践挑战。
items.summaryEn: This article critiques the fundamental assumption underlying current LLM-based 'agent quality gates'—that an LLM can reliably self-assess—and proposes 'deterministic routing + sampling' as a more robust, non-LLM-dependent alternative for agent reliability.

items.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
items.author: Jintao Zhang
items.rawContent: We introduce Vidu S1, a real-time interactive video generation model supporting voice control of digital characters. Users can control video generation content at any moment through voice instructions. Vidu S1 supports infinite-length real-time video generation without blurring, drift, or visual distortion. Built with TurboDiffusion and TurboServe, Vidu S1 outputs 540p real-time videos at up to 42 FPS on regular consumer GPUs. Users can upload custom images of real people, anime, and pets, and c
items.summary: Vidu S1 是一款支持语音实时交互的视频生成模型，可在消费级GPU上以42 FPS输出540p高清视频，并支持上传自定义人物、动漫或宠物图像进行个性化生成。
items.summaryEn: Vidu S1 is a real-time interactive video generation model enabling voice-controlled digital character animation, delivering 540p video at up to 42 FPS on consumer GPUs and supporting custom image uploads (e.g., real people, anime, pets).
items.titleEn: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model

items.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
items.author: Yifan Zhou
items.rawContent: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. IG-Bench is organized around the IdeaGene framework: each paper or proposal is represented as a set of minimal,
items.summary: 本文提出IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench），一个面向科学思想谱系推理与谱系驱动创意生成的新基准，旨在评估AI系统理解并延续科学知识演化脉络的能力。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a novel benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation, designed to evaluate AI systems’ ability to understand and extend the evolutionary inheritance structure of scientific ideas.
items.titleEn: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation

items.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
items.author: Duen Horng Chau
items.rawContent: While UMAP is widely used for exploring high-dimensional data, typical workflows focus on its lower-dimensional embedding, largely overlooking the rich k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph that UMAP constructs internally. This graph encodes the data manifold in its original high-dimensional space, before the distortion that UMAP's 2D projection introduces. We demonstrate the untapped potential of this internal representation, showing how standard graph algorithms applied to this graph enhance data sen
items.summary: 本文探讨UMAP算法内部构建的k近邻图（kNN图）在高维流形表征中的未被充分利用的价值，主张超越传统二维嵌入，直接分析该图以提升数据理解与可解释性。
items.summaryEn: This paper highlights the underutilized k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph constructed internally by UMAP—revealing rich high-dimensional manifold structure before projection—and demonstrates how standard graph algorithms applied to this graph enhance data sensemaking beyond conventional 2D embeddings.
items.titleEn: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
